name: Azure Cosmos DB
sku: Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL and its other APIs. Azure DocumentDB, the MongoDB-compatible vCore service, is a separate offering and is not scored.

source.oltp.note: A fully managed NoSQL and vector database for operational data with single-digit millisecond response times, multi-region writes and models including document, key-value, graph and table. It calls itself a poor fit for analytical workloads and highly relational apps.

bands.note: Automatic patching and updates, autoscale and serverless throughput, and continuous backup with point-in-time restore across regions.

proposed_capabilities.name: Source-side change stream
proposed_capabilities.description: A change feed the database itself exposes, so downstream tools can read row-level changes without a separate CDC product. Scored here as a source feature rather than as ingestion.

proposed_capabilities.name: Vector search for retrieval
proposed_capabilities.description: Storing embeddings next to operational data and searching them by similarity, so an AI application can retrieve the right records to ground an answer. Cosmos DB does this with integrated vector and hybrid search over the same store.

presentation.tagline: Globally distributed NoSQL and vector database for application data.
